note: Original settled senses consistent with the working syllabus; semantic review remains required. This is not a reproduction of assessment stems.

terms.sense: Closeness of a measurement to the accepted true value.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from the agreement of repeated measurements.

terms.sense: How closely repeated measurements agree.
terms.homonym_warning: Repeated readings may agree while sharing a bias.

terms.sense: A stated interval around a measured value within which the true value is expected.
terms.homonym_warning: It is not a known correction to the reading.

terms.sense: Unpredictable variation that scatters repeated readings.
terms.homonym_warning: Averaging can reduce its effect.

terms.sense: A consistent bias introduced by the instrument or method.
terms.homonym_warning: Repeated readings alone do not remove it.

terms.sense: The quantity deliberately changed in an investigation.
terms.homonym_warning: Place it on the horizontal axis when constructing the required graph.

terms.sense: The quantity measured as the response to a deliberate change.
terms.homonym_warning: Place it on the vertical axis in the usual experimental graph.

terms.sense: A quantity held fixed so that the comparison tests the intended change.
terms.homonym_warning: Name the quantity and how it is kept fixed.

terms.sense: Vertical-axis change divided by horizontal-axis change for the chosen line.
terms.homonym_warning: Its physical meaning and unit follow from the actual axes.

terms.sense: A quantity described by magnitude without direction.
terms.homonym_warning: Speed and distance are scalar quantities.

terms.sense: A quantity requiring magnitude and direction.
terms.homonym_warning: Keep the sign convention when adding collinear vectors.

terms.sense: The length of the path travelled.
terms.homonym_warning: It is not necessarily the magnitude of displacement.

terms.sense: The directed change in position from start to finish.
terms.homonym_warning: Wave displacement instead means displacement from equilibrium.

terms.sense: Distance travelled per elapsed time.
terms.homonym_warning: Whole-journey average speed uses total distance and total time.

terms.sense: Rate of change of displacement, with direction.
terms.homonym_warning: Average velocity depends on the net displacement.

terms.sense: Rate of change of velocity.
terms.homonym_warning: A negative value is defined by the chosen positive direction.

terms.sense: The single force equivalent to the vector sum of the forces.
terms.homonym_warning: Balanced forces can be present when the resultant is zero.

terms.sense: Mass multiplied by velocity.
terms.homonym_warning: Conservation of a system's total requires no external resultant force.

terms.sense: A measure of the matter in an object.
terms.homonym_warning: It is not a force and is measured in kilograms.

terms.sense: The gravitational force on an object, equal to its mass times gravitational field strength.
terms.homonym_warning: Its value can change while mass stays fixed.

terms.sense: The resistance of an object's motion to change, associated with its mass.
terms.homonym_warning: It is not an extra force acting on the object.

terms.sense: Mass per volume.
terms.homonym_warning: A volume-against-mass slope is reciprocal density.

terms.sense: Turning effect measured by force times perpendicular lever arm.
terms.homonym_warning: Use instant for a time; do not confuse moment with momentum.

terms.sense: Energy transferred when a force acts through a displacement in its direction.
terms.homonym_warning: Its distance differs from the perpendicular lever arm in a moment.

terms.sense: Energy transferred or work done per time.
terms.homonym_warning: Qualify a mathematical power of ten explicitly.

terms.sense: Perpendicular force per area.
terms.homonym_warning: Area conversions require squared scale factors.

terms.sense: Useful output energy divided by total input energy, usually expressed as a percentage.
terms.homonym_warning: Specify the intended useful output.

terms.sense: Energy needed to raise an object's temperature by one kelvin.
terms.homonym_warning: This is for the whole object, not a unit mass.

terms.sense: Energy per kilogram needed for a one-kelvin temperature rise.
terms.homonym_warning: It concerns a temperature change within a phase.

terms.sense: Energy exchanged during a change of phase with unchanged temperature.
terms.homonym_warning: The syllabus uses this for a quantity of energy, not automatically per kilogram.

terms.sense: Energy per kilogram for a phase change at unchanged temperature.
terms.homonym_warning: Include the unit-mass condition.

terms.sense: Thermal transfer through matter without bulk transport of that matter.
terms.homonym_warning: Electron transfer contributes in metals; do not describe convection instead.

terms.sense: Thermal transport with bulk movement of a fluid, commonly driven by density differences.
terms.homonym_warning: State the physical movement, not just that heat rises.

terms.sense: Transfer of energy by electromagnetic radiation.
terms.homonym_warning: It can occur without a material medium.

terms.sense: Number of complete cycles per unit time.
terms.homonym_warning: It is the reciprocal of period.

terms.sense: Time for one complete cycle.
terms.homonym_warning: Convert milliseconds before obtaining frequency in hertz.

terms.sense: Distance between adjacent points in equal phase along a wave.
terms.homonym_warning: It is distinct from amplitude.

terms.sense: Maximum magnitude of displacement from equilibrium.
terms.homonym_warning: For sound, it is linked to loudness rather than pitch.

terms.sense: A line joining neighbouring points in equal phase.
terms.homonym_warning: A wavefront and the direction of propagation are different representations.

terms.sense: A direction change associated with a change of propagation medium and speed.
terms.homonym_warning: Angles are measured from the normal.

terms.sense: An image formed by rays that actually converge.
terms.homonym_warning: It can be received on a suitably placed screen.

terms.sense: An image located using backward extensions of divergent rays.
terms.homonym_warning: The rays do not actually converge at that location.

terms.sense: Rate of transfer of electric charge.
terms.homonym_warning: Conventional current is opposite electron drift in a metal.

terms.sense: Energy transferred by a source per charge driven around the circuit.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinguish the source's transfer from an individual component's transfer.

terms.sense: Energy transferred in a component per charge passing through it.
terms.homonym_warning: Use volts, equivalent to joules per coulomb.

terms.sense: Potential difference across a component divided by the current through it.
terms.homonym_warning: Air resistance is a drag force, a different meaning.

terms.sense: Current is proportional to potential difference for a conductor whose temperature remains fixed.
terms.homonym_warning: A hot filament does not generally have constant resistance.

terms.sense: Containing iron.
terms.homonym_warning: Do not use it as a substitute for a precise statement about every material's magnetic response.

terms.sense: Atoms of one element with equal proton numbers and unequal nucleon numbers.
terms.homonym_warning: The neutron numbers differ; the element is unchanged.

terms.sense: The number of protons in the nucleus.
terms.homonym_warning: It identifies the chemical element.

terms.sense: The total number of protons and neutrons in a nucleus.
terms.homonym_warning: It is not the neutron number alone.

terms.sense: Spontaneous change of an unstable nucleus with emission of radiation.
terms.homonym_warning: Individual emissions are random.

terms.sense: Time required for half the undecayed radioactive nuclei in a sample to decay.
terms.homonym_warning: Apply successive halvings, not repeated subtraction of half the original sample.
